6befbdbaf66f34c4.table_caption: Each factor is scored from 0 (weak) to 1 (strong), and the composite is the plain average of the four. Sheikh Zayed Road scores well on competition, is middling on demand, and scores zero on cannibalisation because another Bedashing branch is 0.6877 km away. It has no customer rating, so quality is set to a neutral 0.5.
6befbdbaf66f34c4.thresholds_note: PROTECT at a composite of 0.65 or more means the branch clears the bar on most signals, not just one. SHRINK at 0.35 or less means it is weak on most signals. Everything between is HOLD. The middle band is deliberately wide: with no revenue or rent data, the model should only make strong calls when the signals agree.
